heroHeadline: Barcelona Presale Opens for European Leg of Debí Tirar Más Fotos Tour; Met Gala Aged-Prosthetics Look Continues to Dominate Cultural Coverage; Adidas World Cup Campaign Viral
heroSubtitle: Tracking the rise from SoundCloud uploads in Vega Baja to 100 billion Spotify streams, a historic Super Bowl LX halftime performance, and Grammy Album of the Year. On May 8, the Live Nation presale opened for Bad Bunny's sold-out Barcelona shows (May 22–23 at Estadi Olímpic), launching the European leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour. Bad Bunny's May 4 Met Gala transformation — a hyper-realistic aged-future-self using Oscar-winning prosthetics by Mike Marino, paired with a custom Zara tuxedo — remains the defining pop-culture moment of the week, with the viral Kris Jenner hug and debunked Sabrina Carpenter afterparty rumors extending its reach through May 7. On May 6, Adidas dropped its cinematic FIFA World Cup 2026 campaign featuring Bad Bunny, Lionel Messi, Timothée Chalamet, David Beckham, and Zinedine Zidane. 'DtMF' holds 57 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Hot Latin Songs — the all-time chart record — and the European tour continues through Lisbon, Madrid, and beyond.
footerNote: Data sourced from Rimas Entertainment, Billboard, Spotify Newsroom, RIAA, Latin Recording Academy, Recording Academy, Pollstar, Adidas Newsroom, The Hollywood Reporter, Variety, Bloomberg, NPR, Remezcla, Deadline, Complex, Bleacher Report, Rolling Stone, Live Nation, Estadi Olímpic Barcelona, and major media
